donor_source_ids: D. Tong, `Standard Model` lecture notes §2 (davidtong.org/pdfs/teaching/standard-model/standardmodel2.pdf) — vacuum manifold, flat directions of SSB potentials

Cambridge TCM Ginzburg-Landau phenomenology notes (tcm.phy.cam.ac.uk/~achc2/phase/GL.pdf) — degenerate manifold of ground states under global order-parameter rotation implies low-energy (Goldstone) excitations

https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Goldstone_boson — one massless mode per broken continuous generator; excitations along vacuum-manifold flat directions
donor_structure: Landau free energy F(phi) invariant under symmetry group G; spontaneous breaking to H leaves a degenerate ground-state manifold M ~= G/H (Mexican-hat trough). (a) Degeneracy is GENERATED by a group orbit: M = G.x0, not an accident of fine-tuning. (b) Tangent directions along M are exactly flat (zero restoring force) -> Goldstone modes; transverse directions have positive curvature. (c) Small explicit symmetry-breaking terms lift the degeneracy and give Goldstone modes small mass (pseudo-Goldstone). (d) Higgs mechanism: coupling to a gauge field makes flat directions stiff.
target_structure: Optimizer neutral set N(s*) = {s in S : Fit(s) = Fit(s*)} for a search/optimization state s* at optimal fitness: the set over which the optimizer is indifferent; drift within N is neutral
mapping: vacuum manifold M = G/H <-> neutral set N(s*) at optimum
group orbit G.x0 generating M <-> symmetry orbits of representation/permutation operators that preserve fitness (e.g. representation symmetries, parameter redundancies)
Goldstone mode (tangent, massless) <-> neutral moves within N(s*): proposal-kernel moves with zero fitness differential
transverse positive curvature <-> fitness-degrading directions away from N
pseudo-Goldstone lifting by explicit breaking <-> approximate neutrality: near-neutral sets under slightly asymmetric evaluation/noise, neutral drift acquires weak selection
Higgs stiffening <-> tying neutral coordinates to a cost-charged mechanism (metric/measurement coupling that removes indifference)
preserved_relations: degeneracy generated by an orbit (not fine-tuned): fitness-preserving group action partitions S into neutral orbits — same mechanism in both domains
tangent-vs-transverse dichotomy: within-set moves zero-differential, off-set moves strictly penalized (Goldstone/massive split preserved)
lifting: small perturbations turn flat directions into weakly-biased ones (pseudo-Goldstone <-> noise/asymmetry-induced selection on neutral drift)
dimension counting: #neutral directions = dim(M) = dim(G)-dim(H) in physics; in search, #neutral directions = dim(N(s*)) counting fitness-preserving degrees of freedom
known_broken_relations: physics: M is a smooth manifold generated by a CONTINUOUS group with guaranteed Goldstone theorem; search: S is typically discrete/combinatorial — no continuous tangent space, no Goldstone THEOREM, only a graph of zero-differential moves

physics: dynamics within M is gapless (no restoring force at any scale); search: neutrality is exact only under exact fitness evaluation — Burden/measurement cost can break it at finite precision (ties to G10 burden Lipschitz hostile: one edit, burden N*p vs p)
physics: vacuum chosen once, then effectively frozen (superselection); search: the process may revisit/traverse the neutral set — traversal, not selection, is the search-relevant content
unknown_correspondences: does a discrete analogue of Goldstone counting hold (defect-free neutral-path connectivity ~ dim of largest zero-differential subspace)?
is there an analogue of Mermin-Wagner (dimension too low to sustain ordered neutral manifold) for archive/neutral-set maintenance under capacity limits (G15)?
assumptions_added: fitness function plays the role of a variational potential (static landscape; no co-evolutionary ecology drift)
symmetry group of the representation is known/factorable enough to generate orbits (else degeneracy may be accidental, as in non-symmetric GL minima, arXiv:0802.2107)
candidate_theorem: If a fitness-preserving group G_s acts on S with orbits inside level sets of Fit, then the neutral set at the optimum contains the orbit G_s.s*; every orbit direction is an exactly neutral proposal direction; any explicit breaking epsilon of G_s lifts neutrality to bias O(epsilon) (pseudo-Goldstone analogue), and the neutral-set diameter is bounded below by the orbit diameter.
strongest_parent: Goldstone theorem / Landau theory of degenerate ground-state manifolds (structure, not the QFT statement itself); freeze itself lists this pair as a calibration known_positive
proof_route: finite witness: discrete Mexican-hat analogue F(x,y)=(x^2+y^2-1)^2 on Z^2 grid — orbit structure and flat-direction counting check; group-orbit containment is elementary set theory

validation.method: finite witness, discrete Mexican-hat F(x,y)=(x^2+y^2-1)^2 on [-4,4]^2 grid under D4 symmetry
validation.results: min-energy neutral set {(-1,0),(0,-1),(0,1),(1,0)} EQUALS the D4 orbit of (1,0); orbit move dF=0 vs radial move dF=9 (tangent/transverse dichotomy); explicit breaking eps*x lifts neutrality by exactly 2*eps = O(eps) (pseudo-Goldstone analogue)
